description: Creates a one-time, single-use scheduling link for an active Calendly event type, expiring after one booking.

max_event_count.description: The maximum number of events that can be scheduled using this link. For a single-use link, this value must be 1.
max_event_count.title: Max Event Count

owner.description: The URI of the Calendly Event Type that will own this single-use scheduling link. This Event Type's settings (e.g., duration, availability) will apply to the scheduled meeting.
owner.title: Owner

owner_type.description: Identifies the owner resource type, which is 'EventType'.
owner_type.title: Owner Type

name: create_single_use_scheduling_link

resource.description: The main resource object containing the scheduling link data
resource.title: Resource

Resource.description: The resource object containing scheduling link data

booking_url.description: The single-use scheduling link URL that can be shared with invitees to book an appointment. Single use scheduling links that haven't been used to book an event expire after 90 days.
booking_url.title: Booking Url

owner.description: The URI of the event type associated with this scheduling link (e.g., 'https://api.calendly.com/event_types/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA').
owner.title: Owner

owner_type.description: The type of owner for the scheduling link. Always 'EventType' for single-use scheduling links.
owner_type.title: Owner Type
